races.rationale: Ley crossings, planar boundaries, inherited magical marks, and dangerous bargains connect Kaluseban rites to the Keeper of Crossroads.
Planar bloodlines, boundary marks, curses, and binding vows are the clearest expression of Freyseth’s crossroads and pact domains.
Court bargains, dangerous promises, and threshold etiquette make Freyseth an important cautionary patron.
Their liminal balance and work at boundaries between states place crossings under Freyseth.
Choosing which temporal perspective guides the present is treated as a crossing between possible paths.
